reuse.why: Adds the check to assertBankAccountNotLinked, the existing pre-link guard every provider handler calls before creating banks or syncing.

duplication.why: The closed-account rule is written once, not per provider.

placement.why: The guard layer is right (before any write or sync), but the check is folded into a function named and scoped for the uniqueness rule.

scope.why: Only the guard, one test and a release note are added.

maintainability.why: Simple and covers all six providers, though assertBankAccountNotLinked now asserts more than its name says.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in server/accounts/app.ts, called by all six provider link handlers before linkBankSyncAccount.
